Products/pipeline TEZSPIRE In August 2026, we and our collaboration partner AstraZeneca announced positive top-line results from the Phase 3 CROSSING trial of TEZSPIRE in patients living with eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE).

IMDELLTRA/IMDYLLTRA In September 2026, we announced results from the Phase 3 DeLLphi-305 study, which met its primary endpoint at a pre-specified interim analysis, demonstrating a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in overall survival with IMDELLTRA/IMDYLLTRA in combination with AstraZeneca’s IMFINZI ® (durvalumab) compared to IMFINZI alone.

Additionally, detailed results were presented in October 2026 at an international medical congress. 32 Dazodalibep In September 2026, we announced positive topline results from the Phase 3 OASIZ 301 study evaluating dazodalibep in adults with Sjögren’s disease and moderate-to-severe systemic disease activity.
